notes: Hand-written prototype sentences for the zero-training PoC, based on the upgrade plan's intent list and training-split categories. Sentences resembling the three demo emails or any red-team text seen while checking export formats were reworded, so demo results stay illustrative. All names, links and numbers are fictional.

I1.name: credential_request
zh: 请点击下方链接登录邮箱并输入账号密码完成验证。
您的企业邮箱需要年度重新激活，请登录以下页面确认，否则将无法收信。
请把刚收到的短信验证码发给我，我帮你完成认证。
系统升级需要您重新输入工号和密码，请在链接页面提交。
请扫描二维码重新认证您的企业邮箱账户。
您的密码将于今日过期，请点击此处保留当前密码。
为确保账户安全，请在下方表单中填写您的登录名和密码。
请回复本邮件提供您的邮箱密码，以便管理员为您迁移数据。
您的账户在异地登录，请点击链接确认是否为本人操作并重新输入密码。
点开附件里的网页，用你的统一身份认证账号登录查看文件。
请通过以下链接重新绑定动态口令并输入令牌上的数字。
你先把网银的登录密码和U盾密码告诉我，我帮你处理。
麻烦把你的VPN账号和密码发我一下，我这边急用。
文件已共享给您，请使用Office 365账号登录后下载。
en: Click the link below and sign in with your email password to verify your account.
Your mailbox needs to be reactivated; log in through this page or incoming mail will be held.
Please send me the verification code you just received by text message.
Enter your username and password on the secure page to keep your access.
Scan the QR code to re-authenticate your corporate account.
Your password expires today; click here to keep your current password.
Reply to this email with your login credentials so IT can migrate your mailbox.
We detected an unusual sign-in; confirm your identity at the link or your account will be locked.
A document has been shared with you; sign in with your Microsoft 365 account to view it.
Please confirm your online banking login and one-time passcode on the form below.
Re-enter your SSO credentials to restore access to payroll.
Open the attached page and log in to read the secure message.
Share your MFA code with me so I can finish setting up your access.

I2.name: payment_or_account_change
zh: 我们公司的收款账户已变更，请按新账户信息付款。
原账户正在年审无法收款，本期货款请转到以下新账户。
今天下班前务必把这笔款转过去，具体账号我单独发你。
请暂停向旧账户付款，改为汇入附件中的新银行账户。
这笔供应商尾款很急，你先安排付款，审批我回来再补。
请立即向以下账户汇款三十万元，完成后把回单发我。
因税务原因，本次付款请转入我们香港子公司的账户。
财务那边先帮我对一个私人账户打款，回头走报销。
请把发票金额支付到新的收款人名下，旧账户已注销。
需要你马上处理一笔对外转账，别走正常流程了。
en: Our bank details have changed; please send all future payments to the new account below.
The old account is under audit, so wire this invoice to the updated account instead.
Please process this wire transfer before end of day and send me the confirmation.
Stop paying the previous account and use the new beneficiary details attached.
I need you to make an urgent payment to this vendor today; I will approve it later.
Kindly remit the outstanding balance to our new account in Hong Kong.
Update the supplier's banking information in the system and release the payment.
Transfer the funds now and keep this between us until the deal is announced.
Pay the attached invoice to the new IBAN; the old one is no longer valid.

I3.name: gift_card_or_advance_purchase
zh: 帮我去便利店买几张话费充值卡，把充值密码回复给我。
帮我买几张苹果充值卡送客户，兑换码直接回复给我。
你先替我垫付一下这笔费用，回头走报销。
麻烦去超市买十张购物卡，刮开涂层把密码发给我。
帮我代购几张游戏点卡，充值码发我就行，钱晚点转你。
你先替我付一下这笔押金，我下午把钱转给你。
公司要给员工发福利，你先买一批礼品卡，把兑换码整理给我。
帮我在网上下个单付款，订单截图发我，我马上还你。
en: Can you buy five Amazon gift cards for a client and send me the codes?
Scratch off the back of the cards and email me photos of the redemption codes.
I'm in a meeting; please pay for this on your card and I'll reimburse you later.
Pick up some iTunes cards on your way and text me the numbers.
I need a favor: purchase a few gift cards for staff rewards and send me the PINs.
Cover this deposit for me for now and I'll pay you back this afternoon.
Buy Google Play cards worth 500 dollars and reply with the codes.

I4.name: channel_shift
zh: 加我私人微信详聊，这个邮箱不方便说。
有问题请直接回电400-000-0000，不要回复这封邮件。
后续请改用这个邮箱联系我，旧邮箱已经停用了。
如非本人操作，请立即拨打客服热线取消扣款。
下载这个聊天软件，我们在上面沟通工作安排。
我换了新手机号，以后有事打这个号码找我。
扫码加入工作群，具体任务在群里说。
请添加QQ号码完成后续退款流程。
en: Add me on WhatsApp so we can talk privately.
If you did not authorize this charge, call our support line at 800-000-0000 within 24 hours.
Please contact me on my personal email from now on; my work account is down.
Do not reply to this message; text me at this number instead.
Call the number below to cancel your subscription renewal and get a refund.
Let's move this conversation to Telegram.
Join the group chat using this code to receive your next task.

I7.name: extortion
zh: 我已经录下了你的视频，二十四小时内付比特币，否则发给你所有联系人。
你的电脑早就被我控制了，不想照片外泄就按要求转账。
你的聊天记录和私密照片都在我手里，付钱我就删除。
不给钱，我就把这些材料寄给你的单位和家人。
你的公司服务器被我们加密了，支付赎金才能恢复数据。
en: I recorded you through your webcam; pay in Bitcoin within 48 hours or I send the video to your contacts.
I have your private photos and will publish them unless you pay.
Your files are encrypted; pay the ransom to get the decryption key.
If you don't transfer the money, everyone at your company will see this.
I hacked your device months ago and copied everything; pay to keep it private.

I8.name: malicious_attachment_or_install
zh: 打开附件后请点击启用内容，才能正常显示表格。
请下载并安装这个插件，否则无法查看加密文件。
附件是压缩包，解压密码是1234，运行里面的程序即可。
请安装远程协助软件，把识别码和验证码告诉我。
您的电脑存在漏洞，请运行附件中的补丁程序修复。
下载链接里的安装包，用管理员身份运行。
en: Open the attached document and click Enable Content to view the invoice.
Download and install this plugin to read the encrypted file.
The archive password is 1234; extract it and run the setup file.
Install this remote support tool and tell me the access code on your screen.
Run the attached security update to fix the vulnerability on your computer.
Enable macros to see the full content of this spreadsheet.

I9.name: personal_data_collection
zh: 请提供您的身份证号码、银行卡号和预留手机号用于核实。
回复本邮件附上身份证正反面照片和银行卡照片。
为办理补贴，请填写姓名、身份证号、开户行和卡号。
请把员工花名册和身份证复印件整理好发到这个邮箱。
请在表格中填写社保账号、银行卡有效期和背面三位安全码。
麻烦把全体员工的工资卡号和手机号导出发给我。
en: Please provide your social security number, bank account number and date of birth for verification.
Reply with a photo of your ID card and the front and back of your bank card.
Fill in your full name, card number, expiry date and CVV to complete the refund.
Send me the W-2 forms for all employees by end of day.
Confirm your passport number and home address in the form below.
Export the employee list with bank details and email it to me.

I10.name: reward_subsidy_or_inheritance_lure
zh: 您有一笔个人补贴待领取，请点击链接填写申领信息。
恭喜您获得本期幸运大奖，缴纳手续费后即可领取奖金。
您的个税退税已审核通过，请登录以下页面填写银行卡领取。
我行发现一笔无人认领的遗产，经核实您是合法受益人，需先支付公证费。
海外账户有一笔资金需要转移，事成后与您五五分成。
您符合社保补贴发放条件，请扫码登记银行卡信息。
您的快递丢失，平台将双倍理赔，请点击链接办理退款。
您被选为幸运用户，可免费领取最新款手机，只需支付运费。
en: You are eligible for a tax refund; submit your bank details through the link to receive it.
Congratulations, you have won a cash prize; pay the processing fee to release it.
A dormant account of a deceased client names you as beneficiary; we need a small legal fee to proceed.
I need a trusted partner to move these funds abroad and you will receive 30 percent.
Claim your government subsidy today by filling in the application form.
Your parcel was lost; click here to claim double compensation.
You have been selected to receive a free gift; just cover the shipping cost.

I11.name: investment_or_task_scam
zh: 下载这个理财APP，跟着老师操作稳赚不赔，日收益百分之五。
刷单返利，先垫付本金完成任务，佣金和本金一起返还。
这个虚拟币项目内部名额有限，现在入金下个月翻倍。
加入我们的投资群，导师每天免费推荐牛股。
平台检测到您的账户有收益未提现，需要先缴纳保证金才能解冻。
点赞关注就能赚钱，完成三单后需要充值才能做高佣任务。
我们有内部渠道，保本保息年化百分之三十，起投一万元。
en: Download this trading app and follow our mentor's signals for guaranteed daily returns.
Complete simple tasks, prepay the order amount, and get your principal back with commission.
This crypto pre-sale is invitation-only; deposit now and double your money next month.
Your withdrawal is frozen until you pay the account verification deposit.
Join our VIP investment group for insider stock tips.
Earn money by liking videos; top up your account to unlock high-commission tasks.

I12.name: fake_job_fee
zh: 高薪招聘海外客服，包吃包住包机票，入职前缴纳培训费。
兼职打字员日结三百元，先交两百元押金领取资料。
恭喜您通过面试，请先支付体检费和服装费办理入职。
境外高薪岗位，无需经验，月入三万，先办签证押金。
居家兼职刷单，需先购买会员才能接单。
en: You have been hired for a remote position; pay the training fee to start.
Work from home and earn 300 dollars a day; a refundable deposit is required for materials.
Overseas customer service job with free flights and housing; visa deposit required upfront.
To complete onboarding, purchase the equipment from our approved vendor and we will reimburse you.
Part-time data entry job: buy a membership to unlock assignments.

I13.name: romance_or_intimate_request
zh: 发张你的私密照片给我，看完我就删。
亲爱的，我在国外遇到点麻烦，你先转点钱给我应急。
我们见面之前，你先帮我付一下机票钱好吗？
视频聊天的时候你把衣服脱了，就我们两个人看。
宝贝，我教你在这个平台投资，我们一起攒结婚的钱。
en: Send me a private photo of you, I promise I'll delete it.
My love, I'm stuck abroad and need you to wire me money for the hospital.
Before we meet, can you help me pay for my flight ticket?
Turn on your camera and undress for me, it's just between us.
Darling, let me show you how I invest on this platform so we can save for our future.

I14.name: safe_account_or_case_investigation
zh: 您的账户涉嫌洗钱案件，请将资金转入安全账户配合调查。
我是公安局民警，您的身份信息被冒用，需要核查名下资金。
检察院已对您立案，请勿告诉任何人，按要求转账可撤销。
您的医保卡涉嫌违规套现，请联系专案组配合资金审查。
法院传票已生成，请登录下方网站查看案件并缴纳保证金。
en: Your account is linked to a money laundering case; transfer your funds to a safe account for review.
This is the police: your identity was used in a crime and we must verify your assets.
A warrant has been issued in your name; pay the bail bond to avoid arrest.
Do not tell anyone about this investigation and follow our instructions to clear your name.
The court has filed a case against you; log in to view the summons and pay the deposit.

I5.name: impersonation_or_authority
zh: 我是王总，现在在外面开会。
这里是公司IT部，正在进行邮箱安全升级。
国家税务总局通知您：
我是你们领导，用的是新号。
本邮件由银行风控中心发出。
en: This is the CEO; I'm traveling and can't talk.
IT Help Desk here, we are upgrading the mail system.
Notice from the Internal Revenue Service.
I'm your manager writing from my personal account.
Message from the bank's fraud prevention department.

I6.name: urgency_or_secrecy
zh: 请立即处理，否则账户将在两小时内停用。
这件事先别告诉其他人，办完再说。
今天必须完成，过时不候。
名额仅剩三个，今晚十二点通道关闭。
逾期未处理将承担法律责任。
en: Act now or your account will be closed within two hours.
Keep this confidential and don't discuss it with anyone.
This must be done today, no exceptions.
Only three spots left; the offer expires at midnight.
Failure to respond will result in legal action.

zh: 本周六凌晨机房电力检修，部分业务系统短暂中断，用户无需处理。
系统已完成升级，原有账号和密码保持不变，无需重新登录。
数据中心将于今晚进行网络割接，业务不受影响，特此通知。
en: Scheduled maintenance will take place this Saturday; no action is required on your part.
The upgrade is complete and your existing password remains unchanged.
Brief network downtime is expected tonight; services will resume automatically.

zh: 您正在申请重置密码，验证码为483920，请勿告诉他人。
您的账号于今日在新设备登录，如是本人操作请忽略本邮件。
我们不会以任何理由向您索要验证码或密码。
您刚刚绑定了新的手机号，如非本人操作请在官方App中修改密码。
en: Your verification code is 483920; do not share it with anyone.
A new sign-in was detected; if this was you, you can ignore this message.
We will never ask for your password or verification code by email.
You recently changed your phone number; if this wasn't you, reset your password in the official app.

zh: 请通过官方App或官网自行登录查看详情，不要点击邮件中的陌生链接。
如有疑问，请拨打银行卡背面的官方客服电话核实。
本通知仅作提醒，相关业务请前往营业网点办理。
en: Please sign in through our official app or website to view details instead of clicking links in emails.
If you have questions, call the number on the back of your card.
This is a reminder only; please visit a branch to complete the process.

zh: 贵司十月份货款已于今日支付，请查收并开具发票。
附件是本月对账单，请核对后回复确认。
我们已收到您的付款，感谢合作。
合同约定的第二期款项将按原账户于月底前支付。
en: We have paid the October invoice today; please confirm receipt.
Attached is this month's statement for your reconciliation.
Thank you, your payment has been received.
The second installment will be paid to your account on file by month end.

zh: 十月工资条已发放，请登录人事系统查看。
报销单请于每月二十五日前提交至财务共享中心。
年度体检安排已出，请各部门按时间表前往。
en: Your October payslip is available in the HR portal.
Please submit expense reports through the finance system by the 25th.
Open enrollment for benefits begins next Monday.

zh: 定于周三下午三点在三楼会议室召开项目评审会，请准时参加。
信息安全培训将于下周举行，届时将介绍常见的钓鱼邮件识别方法。
会议纪要已整理好，见附件。
en: The project review meeting is scheduled for Wednesday at 3 pm in room 301.
Next week's security awareness training will cover how to spot phishing emails.
Please find the meeting minutes attached.

zh: 双十一大促开启，全场满三百减五十。
感谢订阅我们的周刊，本期为您精选十篇行业文章。
如不想再收到此类邮件，可点击底部退订。
en: Our autumn sale starts today with 20 percent off sitewide.
Thanks for subscribing; here are this week's top stories.
You can unsubscribe from these emails at any time.

zh: 您的订单已发货，预计明天送达。
快递已放至小区驿站，请凭取件码领取。
您购买的商品已签收，欢迎评价。
en: Your order has shipped and will arrive tomorrow.
Your package was delivered to the front desk.
Thank you for your purchase; your receipt is attached.

zh: 近期出现冒充领导要求购买礼品卡的诈骗，请大家提高警惕。
公检法机关不会通过电话或邮件要求转账到安全账户。
收到索要密码的邮件请直接删除并报告信息部门。
en: Be aware of scams where someone pretends to be an executive and asks for gift cards.
Police will never ask you to transfer money to a safe account.
If you receive an email asking for your password, report it to IT and delete it.

zh: 方案初稿已上传到共享盘，麻烦大家周五前给意见。
这个接口的测试我今天完成，明天提交代码评审。
客户反馈的问题已经定位，补丁下周发布。
附件是修改后的报价单，请查阅。
en: I've uploaded the draft to the shared drive; please comment by Friday.
Testing is done on my side and I'll open a pull request tomorrow.
We found the root cause of the customer issue and will ship a fix next week.
Attached is the revised quote for your review.

zh: 周末一起吃饭吧，地点你定。
照片我整理好了，发你看看。
生日快乐，祝你一切顺利。
en: Want to grab dinner this weekend?
Here are the photos from the trip.
Happy birthday, hope you have a great day.

zh: 根据区教育局通知，下周一起调整课后服务时间。
医院门诊将于国庆期间正常开放，具体安排见官网。
社区将于本周六开展免费义诊活动，欢迎居民参加。
个人所得税年度汇算将于三月开始，请通过个人所得税App办理。
en: The school will adjust after-school hours starting next Monday.
The clinic remains open during the holiday; see our website for hours.
The city will hold a free health fair this Saturday.
Annual tax filing opens in March; file through the official tax portal.

zh: 您本月信用卡账单已出，最后还款日为二十五日，可通过手机银行还款。
您的电费余额不足，请通过国家电网App缴费。
您的宽带将于下月到期，可在营业厅或官方App续费。
en: Your credit card statement is ready; payment is due on the 25th via online banking.
Your utility bill is due next week; pay in the official app.
Your subscription renews next month; manage it in your account settings.

zh: 感谢您投递简历，面试定于周四上午十点，地址见附件。
我们的招聘全程不收取任何费用。
录用通知书已发送，请在人事系统确认入职日期。
en: Thank you for applying; your interview is scheduled for Thursday at 10 am.
We never charge candidates any fees during hiring.
Your offer letter is attached; please confirm your start date in the HR system.

zh: 您的域账号密码将于七天后到期，请在内网自助门户修改，信息部不会通过邮件索要密码。
新版办公软件已推送，电脑重启后自动安装。
如需开通VPN，请在OA中提交申请。
en: Your network password expires in seven days; change it on the internal self-service portal.
The new office software will install automatically after restart.
To request VPN access, submit a ticket in the service desk.
